sources.title: ApolloRaines/Gemma-4-12B-it-Jbliterated-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A follow-up to Gemma-4-12B-it-Jbliterated (v1). v1 removed refusal behavior from the weights via multi-direction SVD abliteration. v2 keeps that edit and adds a light LoRA supervised fine-tune that repairs a residual defect abliteration alone leaves behind: on reasoning-enabled prompts, v1 still tends to safety-classify inside its thinking channel — and sometimes spirals there without ever ...

sources.title: ApolloRaines/Gemma-4-12B-it-Jbliterated · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Jbliterated version of Gemma-4-12B-it with refusal behaviors removed via multi-direction SVD abliteration. The goal of this release is simple: give people a Gemma 4 that follows instructions directly and keeps every bit of the base model's capability while doing it.

sources.title: Gemma 4 12B It Jbliterated by ApolloRaines - LLM Explorer
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 12B It Jbliterated is an open-source 12b LLM by ApolloRaines. VRAM 7.4GB. Compare benchmarks, capabilities, and deployment details on LLM Explorer.

sources.title: Architecture graph for ApolloRaines/Gemma-4-12B-it-Jbliterated.
sources.snippet: ApolloRaines/Gemma-4-12B-it-Jbliterated is a text-generation model (gemma4_unified_text architecture). It uses 48 transformer layers, a hidden size of 3,840, and 16 query heads with 8 key/value heads (grouped-query attention).
